description: The reproducible 'local == one-man' spec. The installer consumes this to give a fresh machine the exact plugin + skill set this repo was built from. Content is NOT vendored — plugins install from their marketplaces, design skills from their source. This manifest carries only names, no code, no personal data.
designSkillSource: ~/.agents/skills/<name> — symlinked into ~/.claude/skills/ by the installer when present; these are an external corpus, not shipped by this repo.
